subject: Scheduling: Results convergence session for CloudFinance latency review
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@cloudfinance.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@cloudfinance.io>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial latency figures — can we sync to close gaps?

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the run last week — the team reviewed the initial token-level timings and would like a short session to align on a) which inputs produced the outlier latencies and b) how Redwood's batching/caching knobs affect 95th pct.

Who from your side should join? We'll want a technical readout (SE), a short commercial note on expected unit economics impact (AE), and our procurement/security folks on the line so we can confirm evidence needs.

Available windows for us next week (PST):
- Tue 8/24: 9:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed 8/25: 10:30–12:00

If you can propose a 45–60m slot and share any pre-reads, that would be great.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Platform Engineering
CloudFinance
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@cloudfinance.io>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@cloudfinance.io>, procurement@cloudfinance.io, security-eng@cloudfinance.io
Date: 2027-08-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial latency figures — can we sync to close gaps?

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks — we can run a focused convergence session. Proposed agenda (45m):
- 0–5m: goals and success criteria (Samir)
- 5–20m: SE walk-through of KV/cache/batch behavior on flagged inputs (Karthik)
- 20–35m: quick unit-cost/throughput impact (Rafael)
- 35–45m: open actions and evidence required for procurement/security (Naomi + CloudFinance Sec)

From Redwood we’ll have: Karthik (SE), Rafael (AE), and Naomi (Security/Compliance lead).

I can take Tue 8/24 at 15:00–15:45 PST or Wed 8/25 at 10:30–11:15 PST. Which works best for you?

I’ll attach a short pre-read with the high-level timing slices.

Best,
Mina
Head of Solutions Strategy
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: redwood_latency_summary_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Scheduling: Results convergence session for CloudFinance latency review

Quick internal — Samir is asking to lock a 45m slot. I proposed Tue 8/24 15:00–15:45 or Wed 8/25 10:30–11:15 PST. Can you confirm availability and who will own the demo and the cost note? Also, Karthik, we'll need the specific trace for the 1.2s outlier (sample input set).

Notes: Naomi, procurement will ask for artifacts (logs/retention window) — please confirm whether we can share the filtered traces and what redactions are required.

Thanks — Mina
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Scheduling: Results convergence session for CloudFinance latency review

All good on my side — I can cover the unit economics + expected per-token delta if Karthik leads the demo. I’m booked Tue morning but free Tue 15:00–16:00 and Wed 10:00–12:00.

Karthik, can you prepare a couple slides that map the observed p95/p99 to batching and cache state? If we can show a quick before/after with a tweak, that will make the procurement/security ask simpler.

Rafael
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@cloudfinance.io>, Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@cloudfinance.io>, procurement@cloudfinance.io, security-eng@cloudfinance.io
Date: 2027-08-22T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Results convergence session for CloudFinance latency review

Hi everyone — I’ll lead the technical portion. I can do Tue 8/24 15:00–15:45 PST. I’ll bring:
- a short live trace of the 1.2s outlier and explain cache miss behavior
- a quick demo of changing batch_size and the measured token latencies (local replay)
- a slide showing recommended runtime knobs and expected p95 improvement

Naomi — for traces: I’ll only need the anonymized request payloads and the timing slices. If procurement/security require an explicit NDA or a masked dataset, I can run the replay locally and send redacted artifacts (logs + summary table).

If Tue 15:00 works for CloudFinance, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the readout matrix.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@cloudfinance.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@cloudfinance.io>, procurement@cloudfinance.io, security-eng@cloudfinance.io
Date: 2027-08-25T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Results convergence session for CloudFinance latency review

Thanks — Tue 8/24 15:00 would have worked, but Samir is traveling. Can we move to Wed 8/25 10:30–11:15 PST instead? Procurement has a hard constraint on Thursday; Wed is the only window that works for the security lead.

If you can confirm, we’ll accept the invite. Please include the list of artifacts you plan to share so procurement can pre-review.

Elena
VP, Infrastructure Engineering
CloudFinance
